verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents registrable outbound webhooks that POST to your URL when chosen events occur. They come with full API lifecycle management (create, list, retrieve, update, delete) and UI management, signed payloads with a retrievable verification key, multiple auth methods, and auto-deactivation monitoring. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery; the evidence also does not enumerate the event catalog.
